8.
(1)  Where  a  Commission  appointed  under  the
Commissions  of  Inquiry Act  (Chapter  393)  or  a  Special
Presidential  Commission  of  Inquiry  established  under  the
Special Presidential Commissions Law, No. 7 of 1978 finds
that a person has disappeared or is missing, the next of kin of
that  person  may,  apply  to  the  Registrar-General  or  to  the
District Registrar of Births and Deaths of the district in which
that person was last residing or had his permanant residence,
substantially in the Form set out in the Schedule to this Act,
to register the death of that person under the Births and Deaths
Registration Act (Chapter 110) and to have issued to him, a
Certificate of Death in respect of the death of that person.
